mapper.insert: insert into memory_projection_outbox ( id, tenant_id, app_id, user_id, fragment_id, event_type, topic_name, payload_json, status, attempt_count, available_at, last_error, processed_at, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{appId}, #{userId}, #{fragmentId}, #{eventType}, #{topicName}, #{payloadJson}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{availableAt}, #{lastError}, #{processedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: select id, tenant_id, app_id, user_id, fragment_id, event_type, topic_name, payload_json, status, attempt_count, available_at, last_error, processed_at, created_at, updated_at from memory_projection_outbox where status = 'PENDING' and available_at <= now() order by created_at asc, id asc limit #{limit} for update skip locked
mapper.update: update memory_projection_outbox set status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, last_error = null where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
update memory_projection_outbox set status = 'COMPLETED', processed_at = #{processedAt}, updated_at = #{processedAt}, last_error = null where id = #{id}
